Client-facing professional with 3+ years delivering enterprise SaaS for Fortune 500 organizations — spanning implementation, project delivery, and customer success, from discovery and configuration through training and go-live.

At HighRadius, as an Implementation Consultant I led multiple end-to-end implementations, increased automation from 42% to 70% on key workflows, and recovered a high-risk Cash Application engagement from red to green in under a month.

Currently pursuing an MS in Business Analytics and Information Management at Purdue University’s Daniels School of Business, with a banking analytics practicum at Community First Bank of Indiana.

Open to Project Manager, Implementation Consultant, Solutions Consultant, Professional Services, and Customer Success roles. Open to relocation.
